_about: Public-domain John Donne (1572-1631, Dean of St Paul's) for the Word Hoard: the Devotions upon Emergent Occasions, Death's Duel and the Easter sermon to the Lords clean from CCEL, and Henry Alford's edition of the Works (London: Parker, 1839, 6 vols, chiefly the sermons), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 8 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
